name: Hattie Voss
flavor: Ran the county fair's preserves booth for nine years. Knows exactly what heat does to sugar.

name: Lowell Brace
flavor: Two years of pharmacy school and a suspended licence. Reads a hydrometer like scripture.

name: Adeline Fisk
flavor: Worked a legal distillery until the law changed. Same hands, same nose, different building.

name: Sallie Mott
flavor: Runs six men off the docks. None of them have ever met her husband, who does not exist.

name: Emmett Boyle
flavor: Came back from the Argonne and found peacetime disagreeable. The whole river knows the name.

name: Junie Deel
flavor: Drives the ridge road at night with the headlamps off. Has never lost a load.

name: Cyrus Tarrant
flavor: Four trucks, eleven drivers, and a schedule he keeps entirely in his head.

name: Dot Reaves
flavor: A notary with a rubber stamp and no curiosity whatsoever.

name: Cordell Marsh
flavor: Went to school with two of the three judges. Reminds them of it constantly.

name: Imogen Whitlock
flavor: Has never lost a case because she has never let one reach a courtroom.

name: Beatrice Okonkwo
flavor: Keeps four sets of books and can produce whichever one is asked for.

name: Silas Rennick
flavor: Moved money for a railroad until the railroad noticed. Nothing was ever proven.
